newsitem.title: UK: Gasoil carrier damaged after hitting Panama locks.
newsitem.headline: Gasoil carrier damaged after hitting Panama locks.

text.p: The 32,907 dwt tanker Sonia, loaded with a cargo of gasoil, made contact with the Pedro Miguel locks late on Friday while sailing southbound through the Panama Canal, Lloyd's Shipping Intelligence Service said.

The Maltese-registered vessel sustained some shell damage forward but continued its transit and anchored at Balboa on Saturday for temporary repairs and an official investigation by the canal authorities.
The Sonia had arrived at Cristobal on Thursday.
